# Vicky Feliren

> Applied Scientist specializing in Trustworthy Multimodal AI and Vision-Language Models

Vicky Feliren is an Applied Scientist, AI Engineer / Researcher, Data Scientist working on two problems: making AI systems know when to trust themselves (conformal prediction for vision-language models), and making them culturally relevant to the regions they were never designed for (AI for Southeast Asia). M.Sc. candidate at Monash University. Published in IEEE, ACL, and Remote Sensing of Environment.

## Key Research

- **SEA-VL** (ACL 2025, Major Contributor): Multicultural vision-language dataset for Southeast Asia — 1.28M culturally relevant images across 11 SEA languages. https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.916/
- **ProCANet** (IEEE GRSL 2024, First Author): Progressive cross-attention network for flood segmentation using multispectral satellite imagery — state-of-the-art IoU 0.815 on Sen1Floods11. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10750225
- **Mining Segmentation** (Remote Sensing of Environment, IF 11.4, 2025): Multi-modal deep learning for global mining footprint segmentation across 37 locations. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2024.114584
- **CommonLID** (ACL 2026, Accepted): Human-annotated language identification benchmark covering 109 languages for web data. https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18026
- **Anthropogenic Regional Adaptation** (Under Review 2026): GG-EZ achieves 5–15% gains in cultural relevance for Southeast Asia, retaining 98%+ global benchmark performance. https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11490
- **Retention Ponds Study** (AQUA, IF 2.3, 2025): Urban resilience through flood policy and planning in South Bandung. https://iwaponline.com/aqua/article/74/2/267/106789/
